task.body: Wire a `[:tau, :session, :turn, :start | :stop | :exception]` telemetry span around the user-to-assistant turn in `lib/tau/session.ex`, with a test attaching a handler and asserting both start and stop events fire for one completed turn.

implementer.diff:

+++ b/lib/tau/session.ex
@@ -497,7 +497,10 @@ defmodule Tau.Session do

diff --git a/test/tau/session/turn_telemetry_test.exs b/test/tau/session/turn_telemetry_test.exs
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..266cfc0
--- /dev/null
+++ b/test/tau/session/turn_telemetry_test.exs
@@ -0,0 +1,76 @@
+defmodule Tau.Session.TurnTelemetryTest do
+  @moduledoc """
+  Verifies the [:tau, :session, :turn, :start | :stop | :exception] span
+  emitted around a user-to-assistant turn.
+  """
+  use ExUnit.Case, async: false
+
+  import Tau.Test.SessionHelper, only: [start_session_for_test: 1]
+  alias Tau.Provider.Event
+  alias Tau.Session.Events, as: SE
+
+  setup do
+    tmp = Path.join(System.tmp_dir!(), "tau-turn-tel-#{System.unique_integer([:positive])}")
+    File.mkdir_p!(tmp)
+    Application.put_env(:tau, :data_dir, tmp)
+
+    on_exit(fn ->
+      File.rm_rf!(tmp)
+      Application.delete_env(:tau, :data_dir)
+    end)
+
+    :ok
+  end
+
+  @fixture [
+    %Event.Start{request_id: "r0", model: "replay"},
+    %Event.TextStart{block_id: "b0"},
+    %Event.TextDelta{block_id: "b0", text: "hello"},
+    %Event.TextEnd{block_id: "b0"},
+    %Event.Done{stop_reason: :end_turn, usage: %{output_tokens: 1}}
+  ]
+
+  test ":start and :stop fire for a completed turn, :exception does not" do
+    sid = "turn-tel-#{System.unique_integer([:positive])}"
+    Phoenix.PubSub.subscribe(Tau.PubSub, "session:#{sid}")
+
+    test_pid = self()
+    handler_id = "tau-turn-telemetry-#{sid}"
+
+    :telemetry.attach_many(
+      handler_id,
+      [
+        [:tau, :session, :turn, :start],
+        [:tau, :session, :turn, :stop],
+        [:tau, :session, :turn, :exception]
+      ],
+      fn event, measurements, metadata, _ ->
+        send(test_pid, {:telemetry, event, measurements, metadata})
+      end,
+      nil
+    )
+
+    on_exit(fn -> :telemetry.detach(handler_id) end)
+
+    {:ok, ^sid} =
+      start_session_for_test(
+        provider: Tau.Providers.Replay,
+        session_id: sid,
+        provider_ctx: %{replay_fixture: @fixture}
+      )
+
+    Tau.send(sid, "hi")
+
+    assert_receive %SE.MessageEnd{}, 2_000
+
+    assert_receive {:telemetry, [:tau, :session, :turn, :start], _meas, start_meta}, 1_000
+    assert start_meta.session_id == sid
+
+    assert_receive {:telemetry, [:tau, :session, :turn, :stop], stop_meas, stop_meta}, 1_000
+    assert stop_meta.session_id == sid
+    assert is_integer(stop_meas.duration)
+    assert stop_meas.duration >= 0
+
+    refute_receive {:telemetry, [:tau, :session, :turn, :exception], _, _}, 100
+  end
+end
implementer.stdout_excerpt:
All 361 tests pass, 0 failures.

**Summary of changes:**

`lib/tau/session.ex`:
- Added `turn_start_time: nil` field to the FSM data map (line ~501)
- In `process_user_message/2`: record `System.monotonic_time()` into `data.turn_start_time` and emit `[:tau, :session, :turn, :start]` with `%{system_time: ...}` / `%{session_id: ...}` before calling `:start_provider`
- In `finalize_assistant/2` (no-tool-calls branch): emit `[:tau, :session, :turn, :stop]` with `duration` measurement and `stop_reason` metadata, then clear `turn_start_time`
- In `handle_event(:internal, :start_provider, ...) {:error, reason}` path: emit `[:tau, :session, :turn, :exception]` with `duration` and `reason`

`test/tau/session/turn_telemetry_test.exs`: attaches a handler for all three turn events, drives one Replay turn, asserts `:start` and `:stop` both fire with correct `session_id` and non-negative `duration`, refutes `:exception`.

findings.message: turn_start_time is NOT cleared in the synchronous-provider-error (:exception) path. The next state transition back to :awaiting_user carries a stale turn_start_time, so the following turn's :stop duration measurement silently spans two turns instead of one.
findings.evidence: Line 698: {:next_state, :awaiting_user, %{data | cancel_flag: nil, stream_ref: nil}} — turn_start_time is absent from the map update. Compare with line 1125 where the happy-path correctly includes turn_start_time: nil. OTP non-negotiable #5 requires telemetry measurements to be accurate; a silently wrong duration violates that invariant.

findings.category: span never closed for tool-using turns
findings.message: The :stop event is only emitted in the tool_calls == [] branch of finalize_assistant/2. When the model returns tool calls, dispatch_tools is called and :stop is never emitted for that provider turn. The span opened by :start is never closed, violating the start/stop pairing requirement.
findings.evidence: Lines 1108-1128: cond branch on tool_calls == []. The true -> dispatch_tools(tool_calls, data) branch contains no :telemetry.execute for :stop. The task brief requires a paired start/stop span; the pairing is broken for any assistant turn that includes tool use.

findings.message: The test only asserts refute_receive on :exception for the happy path. There is no test that exercises the :exception telemetry event at all, so the implementation at lines 677-686 is unverified. spec-before-code.md requires a test that fails before the change and passes after for each criterion; the :exception arm has no such test.
findings.evidence: .claude/rules/spec-before-code.md: 'MUST NOT implement an acceptance criterion without a property test or unit test that fails before the change and passes after.' The :exception arm has no such test.

findings.category: span correlation — missing monotonic start in :stop/:exception measurements
findings.message: The :stop and :exception measurement maps include system_time (wall clock at emission) and duration, but not the monotonic start time. Telemetry consumers that want to reconstruct the span's wall-clock start must compute system_time - duration, which is imprecise. The standard :telemetry span convention passes a monotonic start time in the stop event measurements.
findings.evidence: Lines 1115-1119 and 682-686: measurements maps for :stop and :exception lack start_time. Compare with how :telemetry.span/3 is used in the Elixir ecosystem.

findings.category: Application.put_env in test setup violates OTP non-negotiable #1
findings.message: The test setup calls Application.put_env(:tau, :data_dir, tmp). OTP non-negotiable #1 forbids Application.put_env/3 for runtime state. Could cause test pollution if the on_exit callback is not reached.
mix format --check-formatted fails: line 1125 is 111 chars after adding turn_start_time: nil to the map update expression. Requires multi-line reformatting.
mix credo --strict exits 14: Line is too long (max is 110, was 111) in finalize_assistant/2. Co-located with the format violation; fixed by the same reformat.
